CustomField.description: The API name of a custom permission. Saves made by people who hold it do not recalculate or queue this rollup; the nightly run and Recalculate still cover it. Must name a custom permission in the org.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. People with this custom permission, such as a data migration user, do not update this total when they save records. Leave blank so everyone does.
CustomField.label: Bypass Permission
